dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Distinct concave trailing edge curve extending from the posterior dorsal ridge to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute shape classification with a narrow pixel radius at the maximum morphological height.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 45-degree posterior slope relative to the longitudinal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Base width to vertical height ratio is approximately 1.4:1.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smooth convex curve with a broad arc radius forming the anterior-dorsal cranial profile.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Tapered beak extension with a length roughly 0.4x the melon height.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle where the melon slope transitions into the rostrum base.

other_distinctive_markers: Uniform monochromatic cyan luminescence across the entire morphological surface against a black background.
